mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600K, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals decreased economic output, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of real disposable personal income (RSAFS) above 600B signals increased consumer spending power, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and retail sales
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals an inflationary monetary policy environment, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical monetary policy and inflation indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.018 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tight labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-UNRATE periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above 19000B and 1550K, respectively, signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP and housing market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
